item.title: Billboard Hot 100 Top 10 Countdown for May 9, 2026 | Billboard News
item.description:
[Upbeat music introduction]
Host: Welcome to the Billboard Hot 100 update. This week, we've got some exciting new entries and shifts in the top 10. Let's dive in.
Two new tracks have cracked the top 10: Ella Langley and Morgan Wallen's "I Can't Love You Anymore" debuts at number 7, and Noah Kahan's "Doors" opens its way to number 9.
But the big question is, can any of Ella Langley's three entries in the top 10 claim the number 1 spot from Olivia Rodrigo's "Drop Dead"? Not this week, as "Drop Dead" drops to number 4. Instead, "Choosin' Texas" returns to the top spot for its eighth week.
Here's a quick rundown of the top 10: "Folded" stays put, "Ordinary" falls to 8, "So Easy" rises to 6, "Be Her" holds steady at 5, "Man I Need" jumps to 3, and "I Just Might" takes the second spot.
[Outro music starts]
Host: That's all for this week's Billboard Hot 100 update. If you want to stay up-to-date on the latest music news, be sure to subscribe and hit the notification bell. Thanks for tuning in! [Outro music continues to play until the end]
